verdict.rationale: A runtime probe confirms jo publishes a canonical llms.txt at askjo.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200, text/plain). It tells agents to prefer it over scraping the site and documents surfaces, integrations, architecture, model routing and pricing. A machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec is also served at /openapi.json. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents successfully using these docs, and agent-oriented developer documentation around the OpenAPI spec (no developer program or public API keys are documented).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: keyless GET of https://askjo.ai/llms.txt returned jo's canonical llms.txt (text/plain)

which tells agents to prefer it over scraping the site and documents surfaces (macOS/Telegram/WhatsApp/email), the wired-up integrations list, the per-user Fly machine architecture, ZDR model routing, and pricing
